factor_parity.meaning: On this archive the stored live factor signals are byte-equal to the replay implementation's, so the unavailable-versus-zero conversion repair cannot change a single archived directional call; it only changes days whose level inputs are absent, which do not occur here.

engine_stored_archive.source: committed parity archive of the live workflow's stored calls

engine_replayed_asof.source: backtester/replay/usd/usd_replay_core.js on this dataset's as-of observations, with the event and Fed-bias families explicitly missing

baseline_always_bullish.source: Majority-direction benchmark: every evaluable day called bullish.

baseline_momentum_usd_ret_1d.source: one-day dollar momentum benchmark: follow the trailing return's sign.

baseline_momentum_usd_ret_5d.source: five-day dollar momentum benchmark: follow the trailing return's sign.

baseline_contrarian_usd_ret_1d.source: one-day dollar mean-reversion benchmark: fade the trailing return's sign.

baseline_contrarian_usd_ret_5d.source: five-day dollar mean-reversion benchmark: fade the trailing return's sign.

composite_engine_aligned_weights.source: Same rules, weights redistributed to follow the live 24h factor budget by family.

composite_equal_weights.source: All evaluable candidate rules on their declared weights with the full gates.

challenger_logistic_l2_0.1.source: L2 logistic challenger (lambda 0.1) on 17 standardised features, fitted on development rows only.

single_rel_us_2y_chg5d.source: Single-rule arm: Higher US front-end yields raise the dollar's carry; the live F2 threshold is 5bp and is treated as provisional.

single_risk_vix_level_haven.source: Single-rule arm: The live F1 regime mapping: high VIX is a dollar haven bid.

single_xasset_gold_5d_inverse.source: Single-rule arm: The live F6 mapping: gold strength is read as dollar weakness.

single_rel_us_de_2y_spread_chg5d.source: Single-rule arm: The engine's own F3 idea: the spread change is the relative-rate signal, not either leg alone.

notes: Every arm is scored on the same rows, the same flat band (0.1pp on the broad dollar index) and the same chronological periods.
engine_stored_archive is the only arm that is a measurement of live behaviour; every other arm is a local computation.
No arm in this file may be read as a trading edge: no spread, cost, fill or path evidence exists here.
